title: Animation editor options get grayed out on non-read-only animations
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: v4.7.2.stable.official [ed1daf0bf] ### System information Godot v4.7.2.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1060) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13650HX (20 threads) - 15.69 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description Sometimes, the options popup for the currently selected animation (referring to the screenshot) will disable many options on an animation that supports those options: This may happen when opening the animation window after reloading Godot, or after moving a sprite with Auto Insert Key enabled. (Most easily occurs with AnimatedSprite2Ds when they automatically open the SpriteFrames panel.) The options are only expected to be disabled when looking at a read-only animation, or with no animation selected. Summary and source code explanation of the issue from a Reddit comment: https://www.reddit.com/r/godot/comments/1x7r924/comment/pheo5dt/?screen_view_count=2 ### Steps to reproduce - Add a Node2D to the scene - Add an AnimationPlayer to the scene - Open the animation panel and create a new animation - Add a property track for the Node2D's position - Enable Auto Insert Key (record) - Close the animation panel - Drag the Node2D to change its position - Click back on the AnimationPlayer in the scene tree (to automatically open the Animation panel) - Now, opening the "Animation" popup should show the options grayed out ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
